notes.title: 0.15.11 Beta - Big Turn to Big Chests
notes.content:
[h3]New Block - Chest[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/04f9404ee27a7197e37e4dab7dcbf3f802137fe0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Each individual chest can store 800 of a single type of block
[*]Multiple chests can be welded together to create a bigger chest
[*]Welded chests can store welded structures
[*]Chests will automatically pick up adjacent blocks
[*]Chests extrude blocks when powered (extruding face has to be flat)
[*]Unwelding two chests that store welded items will also unweld the stored blocks
[*]After researching "Stacked Fabrication", welding two chests can weld the stored items, if they have the same stack count.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/e5eadcd59e2f809a0e4c130bca0958b26fb92c33.png[/img]

[h3]New Uses for Catalyst Core[/h3]
[list]
[*]Catalyzed Motors can rotate welded structures, as an instant teleportation

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/a3dabd7567f0a586483dc2744a48efb377b71589.gif[/img]
[*]Catalyzed Displays make a large 5x5 hologram. The mouse cursor disrupts holograms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/6e50b8f422c565b48499c41f8e63528f8d9042e4.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Block Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pedestals can pull out of chests
[*]Extractor, Combiner, and Creator now ignore inductors on the front AND back
[*]Teleportores now have a trail effect
[*]Sensors on charge mode detect emitter blocks, actuators, and actuator bases
[*]Sensors on machining mode now detect manipulators and emitter blocks

[*]Accelerometers and sensors in moving mode now update after blocks that push
[*]Tweaked update propagation for teleportores teleporting teleportores
[*]Sensors on charge mode now update after wires and superconductors
[*]Combiner combining is now on a lower update rank than combiner extrusion

[*]Pushes that hit a search depth of 1000 now instantly fail, instead of looking for an alternate route. The search for an alternate route was a massive performance hit that rarely would succeed. This change is effectively is a more consistent global push limit of 1000 blocks.
[/list]

[h3]Block Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed teleporting dynamic data blocks, like command block or chest
[*]Fixed some cases of water disappearing
[*]Fixed beams not changing color when a beam goes through a glass while that glass is being injected
[*]Water being next to other water no longer prevents it from being teleported
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*]When interacting with inventories, tap right click over an empty slot to drop 1
[*]Added WAILA info for spark catcher
[*]The backpack window can now be moved when it is bigger than the game window
[/list]

[h3]Technical Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added \n newlines to localization files
[*]Console command prefer_backpack_over_hotbar that changes the behavior of holstering blocks
[*]Added new command buggy_disable_global_push_unfail. This will probably break things, but is useful for performance testing,
[*]Added new command buggy_disable_light_updates. This will definitely break lighting and sensors on light mode, but is useful for performance testing
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a startup crash when shaders are disabled
[*]Localization files that are not valid UTF-8 will now log a message in the console instead of crash
[*]Fixed argument parsing for grant_passive
[*]Fixed guidebook crash
[*]Fixed a crash when piecing together pieces of the background diorama
[*]zoom <level> command is now limited to the same as zoom_increase and zoom_decrease
[*]removed duplicate translation BLOCK_STATE count
[*]Fixed particles on tile_tick_multithread
[*]Fixed particle lifetime when in chair
[*]Fixed crash when a sound in an unloaded chunk gets unloaded when tile_tick_multithread was on
[/list]

notes.title: 0.14.10 Beta - Better Building
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=bAl0i3-1wtM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Building and Welding Updates[/h3]
Improved existing building modes and added new features
These new features are showcased in tutorial: Advanced Building

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Mouse[/th]
        [th]Mode[/th]
        [th]Ctrl Pressed[/th]
        [th]Action[/th]
        [th]Update[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]left[/td]
        [td]build[/td]
        [td][/td]
        [td]Place Block[/td]
        [td]fixed gaps when dragging quickly[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]right[/td]
        [td]build[/td]
        [td][/td]
        [td]Pick Up Block[/td]
        [td]fixed gaps when dragging quickly[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]left[/td]
        [td]weld[/td]
        [td][/td]
        [td]Weld[/td]
        [td]can now draw a long line of welds
and then watch them all complete[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]right[/td]
        [td]weld[/td]
        [td][/td]
        [td]Unweld[/td]
        [td]can now draw a long line of welds
and then watch them all complete[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]left[/td]
        [td]build[/td]
        [td]ctrl[/td]
        [td]Replace Block[/td]
        [td]New Feature!
It unwelds, picks up, places, and welds[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]right[/td]
        [td]build[/td]
        [td]ctrl[/td]
        [td]Pick Up Block,
including non-weld connections[/td]
        [td]fixed gaps when dragging quickly,
and changed how magnets interact with
player-frozen blocks to be more consistent[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]left[/td]
        [td]weld[/td]
        [td]ctrl[/td]
        [td]Place Block and Weld in Line[/td]
        [td]New Feature![/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]right[/td]
        [td]weld[/td]
        [td]ctrl[/td]
        [td]Unweld and Pick Up Block[/td]
        [td]New Feature![/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h4]Other changes to building[/h4]
[list]
[*]Pipette (used to be called pick_block) can now holster. Q is now default bound to pipette instead of holster
[*]Manually extracting can now go directly in-hand
[*]"+scroll_control can now change rotate/flip commands", similar to "+build_mode_not"
[*]Removed the button to easily switch to the "combomouse" input scheme
[*]new cheat allow_nonbuildable <on/off> allows picking up and welding command blocks, boundaries, spawners
[*]blocks with extra data (command blocks and spawners) keep their data, even in the inventory
[*]blocks with extra data (command blocks and spawners) need to have the same data to stack
[*]Welding/Unwelding now has random variation to sound
[/list]

[h3]Experimental Multithreading[/h3]
Added new experimental setting: "tile_tick_multithread <on/off>".
This command puts all the calculations that make blocks move on another thread, smoothing out frame skips and freezes
[b]It is recommended to make backups of any saves before trying this out[/b]
This change has let to the rewriting of a lot of the game engine, fixing crashes, but possibly causing new ones

[h3]Debug Console Overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*]new commands press_held_input <input>, unpress_held_input <input>, toggle_held_input <input> and clear_pressed_held_inputs. Mimics holding down a held key (like +jump)
[*]console syntax sugar: +jump expands to press_held_input jump, -jump expands to unpress_held_input jump
[*]renamed "pick_block" to "pipette"
[*]renamed "clear" command to "backpack_clear"
[*]renamed "at_tile" command to "at". Now has suffixes for (c)hunk, (p)ixel, etc. Can now use ~ for relative coordinates
[*]alias and bind now require the command to be in quotes if it is longer than one word
[*]"schedule" command is now split into schedule_console, schedule_client, and schedule_world
[*]freecam, gif_static and schedule commands now have suffixes for time argument
[*]added -headless startup option
[*]added new command "warp <time>"
[*]added new command "window_freeze_debug_messages <on/off>"
[/list]

[h3]Block Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]changed what sides of creator and manipluator stick to slime
[*]magnets will no longer drop blocks when player-frozen
[*]made updates to air directly in front of beam cores more consistent
[*]Changed the sounds of the dismantler and destroyer
[*]Fixed destroyer not being able to switch sounds

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.13.2 beta
notes.content:
This update will likely break some contraptions!

[h3]Block changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Block[/b] - [b]Superconductor[/b].
Instantly transmits charge in one direction without decay

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/c0bb34f2fb03da70d09efc05cf54d1c04b9a17cb.gif[/img]

[*]Yellow beams now need a lot more space to grow trees
[*]Yellow beams can now weld leaves, logs, and dirt together
[*]Tweaked tree growing algorithm

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/b7ac038713b07258b32840bb5b1ab6913d22d7c2.gif[/img]

[*]Motors are now faster
[*]Fixed a bug where injectors would get double updated when collecting a block and then immediately injecting
[*]Slow progress blocks (motors, extractors, arc furnace, etc) no longer cancel if their target block starts moving on the last tick of progress

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/fa96f070f34483ae92bfca758e779bb99095851e.gif[/img]

[*]Galvanometer no longer adds one

[*]The thin ends of actuator heads and bases now can only weld to each-other

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/2564e43e5f016edbc731943d024849c283435ada.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Ranked Update Order[/h3]
[list]
[*]Update order now depends on block type. This will make contraptions more intuitive and consistent.
[*]Wires and beams now update breadth first instead of depth first

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/d7b3e3da3e93cf25305c51be657dedf4f44d271e.gif[/img]
[*]Force cores already moving in their faced direction are now lower in the update order ranking, making diagonal motion reliable

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/d8cfa5dac9dba86616d1bfc4529773f579f741cf.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Changed recipes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed old inductor recipe, increased product count of the new one
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Empty hotbar slots can now be locked to stop anything from entering them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/648279d4fe42a25a1315569ea9dc06d14408065b.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Technical changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Gifs no longer glitch out when recording slow progress blocks
[*]Greatly improved the performance of particles
[*]Improved cloud rendering performance, especially at high resolutions
[/list]

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.12.0 beta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/4cb46a43f5d1ed9321479d026717a2c1ee946e06.png[/img]
[h2]New Blocks[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Chert[/b]
    A new type of rock that generates in clumps underground.
    Replaces oxide in the recipes for dismantler, destroyer, and extractor.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/8e081b59fc3270e8113e47b4d92477a754dc4423.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/0ae5cf8536c0b38a3d132fc47c4c17f9979243fa.png[/img][/url]
[*][b]Compressed Chert[/b]
    Works the same as compressed stone, but for chert.
[*][b]Spark Catcher[/b]
    Catches sparks from some operating machines. Sends a signal when it catches a spark.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/f521f2c97724b113c78fda91ed5116e55da77c2a.gif[/img]
[*][b]Spark Emitter[/b]
    Uses sparks caught in a spark catcher and shoots them out. Can be used to send signals or damage creatures.
[*][b]Bomb Emitter[/b]
    Creates bombs
    Bombs unweld blocks and can convert stone into chert.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/b6e9084a78f64cb853684645daa54db842e2a1e8.gif[/img]
[*][b]Slime[/b]
    Sticks to blocks, but blocks don't stick to slime. Replaces residue in the core ore recipe
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/63f30fe4a99dbe8fe443a1a4328f9f4f9c43a198.gif[/img]
[*][b]Slimice[/b]
    Half slime, half ice
[*][b]Divider[/b]
    Circuit component that divides signals by two. Quotient goes out the front, remainder goes out the side.
[/list]

[h2]Block Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Sand, pulp, and sawdust now consistently slide off of other blocks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/15b040ba599d815ec57937faae048c6d45a5b3c9.gif[/img]
[*]Residue can now only be welded to other residue.
[*]Matchers welded together now work together, only sending a signal when all linked matchers match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/4ede2e05f030732e5891d441db6c7dc53ad1ddef.gif[/img]
[*]Sensor on container count mode now detects water inside foam.
[*]Combiner no longer gets charge from inductors on the input face.
[/list]

[h3]Expanded research tree[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/f43b183613d20851f5b593f84984ec82497309d4.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New research for new blocks
[*]Vehicle now needs 100 rubber
[*]Mass Core no longer needs stone
[/list]

[h3]Changed recipes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Core Ore now takes slime instead of residue. Can use compressed chert or compressed stone interchangeably. Now has two variations for either parity of the checkerboard pattern.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/98d84683f67eed3b9f8ada516def1a3e41c56982.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Picking up structures larger than 2x4 or 3x3 is no longer instant. Right clicking will slowly freeze the structure. Large structures will only be picked up when entirely frozen. If the welded structure of blocks can't be picked up (such as being too big), only the one block under the mouse is frozen.
[*]Frozen blocks no longer unfreeze for any player movement, only player movement relative to the ground they are standing on.
[*]Improved consistency of standing on moving blocks.
[*]When a hotbar slot gets empty, a new stack of blocks will be automatically pulled from the backpack if available.
[*]Noclip movement is snappier.
[/list]

[h3]Technical changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reorganized the input menu. The following commands were previously only bindable via the console, but are now featured in the input menu:
        backpack_sort
        adjust_increase
        adjust_decrease
[*]Sensor modes natural and rare-resource are now defined by recipes.smp. Fixed an oversight: ice is now a "natural" block.
[*]Removed some recipes from unintended guidebook pages (such as the inductor page).
[*]The orientation of blocks in the guidebook are now defined by recipes.smp instead of being hardcoded. [*]Lighting is now correct on rotated blocks in the guidebook and UI.
[*]Changed the format of entities.smp and research_objectives.smp to make it possible for custom files to only override specific entries.
[*]Made the effects of yellow beam and leaf fire on entities consistent, regardless of grid position.
[*]Made detection of icy floors more accurate.
[*]The research tree can use blocks for icons, instead of having to use the research_icons.png texture
[/list]

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.10.0 beta pre-release 6
notes.content:
[h2]World Generation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Snow Biome
[list]
[*]Pine Trees
[*]Snow
[*]Icy lakes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/d3005ea146473ec7ffa54eb889b81f3b7ab85b95.png[/img]
[*]Tree planting is more varied
[/list]

[h2]New Blocks[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Snow[/b] - Crushable like grass. When 4 of them stack, it turns into ice. Can be extracted from ice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/c0a6baee75faf71830e709156ff9ab3ce6aee393.gif[/img]
[*]The existing "log" and "leaf" are now "maple log" and "maple leaf"
[*][b]Pine Log[/b] and [b]Pine Leaf[/b] - grows straighter than maple trees. Found in snowy biomes. Only pine trees can grow when covered in snow.
[*][b]Sawdust[/b] - extracted from pine logs
[*][b]Prism[/b] - reflects different colors of beam in different directions. This makes beam splitting and merging possible

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/f486a04f40100f14aa9fec2451e13a8f12154698.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Block Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed beam shader
[*]Yellow, Cyan, and Magenta beams now have unique effects
[*]Blue beams now kill grassy dirt and turn small plants into snow
[*]Grassy dirt now has 2 variations and dirt fertility has been overhauled
[*]Platforms update instantly when welded or unwelded
[*]Frames and frame styled blocks (wires, togglers, detectors, etc) are slightly fancier. Note the lack of a dot grid in the middle of all these frames
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/3cf798b45b0c2f08771a3c660fcd03a0b35089b4.png[/img]
[*]Catalyst Core now shows what blocks it is catalyzing
[*]Magnet can now be catalyzed (missing from earlier patch notes)
[*]Injector can now be catalyzed to increase range
[*]Various texture changes, especially mantler and transistor
[/list]

[h2]Recipe Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Injector recipes now use sawdust instead of maple logs
[*]Beam core recipe now uses a lamp instead of a force core
[*]Telecross's recipe now has aligned raw cores and needs a calcium bar
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mouse hovering over various blocks with ranges displays that range, such as the injector vs. a catalyzed injector
[*]Beams now show in the WAILA when mouse hovering air
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Various changes to update order
[*]Fixed collectors getting smooshed
[*]Detectors should be more consistent
[*]Recording gifs now create a single pallet for the entire game, instead of per-frame. This reduces jitter in gifs, but generally lowers the number of colors able to be displayed. Fullbright is now an option for gifs.
[*]Fixed catalyzed chairs not acting the same as catalyzed pilot chairs
[*]Generating a large dungeon no longer flashes the screen
[/list]

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.10.0 beta pre-release 3
notes.content:
[h2]New Blocks[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Counter[/b] - Counts pulses. Adjustable and resetable.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/524b4aa9e099b0b7b38b5963b8bc158b2e16dacb.gif[/img]

[h2]Block Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Rollers and dynamic rollers now get powered together when welded together. Rollers can no longer be welded to dynamic rollers

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added camera damping. Can be adjusted or disabled in the options menu

[*]Reorginized guidebook catagories
[*]Mouse hovering over a spawner shows its range

[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Roody:2d 0.10.0 beta pre-release 2
notes.content:
[h2]New Blocks[/h2]
[list]
[*]The [b]pedestal[/b] makes blocks available to be summoned
[*]The [b]summonore[/b] summons available blocks. Fueled by plant matter.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775098/63e37a443f40553fc9dba2929b77b7b0acdc2f3f.gif[/img]

[h2]Recipe Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mass core now costs 2 raw cores, down from 4
[*]Catalyst Core now costs 2 refined core, down from 4
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added more details to guidebook
[*]Applicable encyclopedia tutorials have research disabled
[*]Using pick-block on a toggler no longer copies its on/off state
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]When blocks move, two things happen: the block moves, and blocks around it get added to the update que. When multiple blocks moved, these two actions are no longer collated. When they were collated previously, sometimes a block position would get queued to update and then the block would move away, causing the block to not get updated.
In summary: moving blocks no longer forget to act.
[/list]
